options.text: Yes please, I need woad leaves.

steps.player: Yes please, I need woad leaves.

steps.npc: How much are you willing to pay?

steps.npc: Here, have two, you're a generous person.

options.text: How about ME helping YOU instead?

steps.player: How about ME helping YOU instead?

steps.npc: That's a nice thing to say. I do need a hand, now you mention it. You see, there's some stupid mole digging up my lovely garden.

steps.player: A mole? Surely you've dealt with moles in the past?

steps.npc: Ah, well this is no ordinary mole! He's a big'un for sure. Ya see... I'm always relied upon to make the most of this 'ere garden - the faster and bigger I can grow plants the better!

In my quest for perfection I looked into 'Malignius-Mortifer's-Super-Ultra-Flora-Growth-Potion'. It worked well on my plants, no doubt about it! But it had the same effect on a nearby mole. Ya can imagine the
havoc he causes to my patches of sunflowers! Why, if any of the other gardeners knew about this mole, I'd be looking for a new job in no time!

steps.player: I see. What do you need me to do?

steps.npc: If ya are willing maybe yer wouldn't mind killing it for me? Take a spade and use it to shake up them mole hills. Be careful though, he really is big!

steps.player: Is there anything in this for me?

steps.npc: Well, if yer gets any mole skin or mole claws off 'un, I'd trade 'em for bird nests if ye brings 'em here to me.

steps.player: Right, I'll bear it in mind.
